                                                                 U.S. AIR FORCE TECHNICAL INFORMATION


                                This questionnaire has been prepared so that you can give the U.S. Air Force as much
                         information as possible concerning the unidentified aerial phenomenon that you have observed.
                         Please try to answer as many questions as you possibly can. The information that you give will                                                                         ••
                                                                                                                                                                                                               •

                                                               Additional Comments
                                                                                                     •


                                     Just before sunrise, a fairly pronounced temperature inversion
                                     developed over much of Minnesota. It is the opinion of division
                                     weather officers that no significant .inversion would have been
                                     likely at the time ot the sightings. All of the sightings were
                                     near, but never over, lakes, a fact not in itself significant
                                     in view of the large number of lakes in this area.    The w~ather
                                     officers believe the lakes would tend to destroy or weaken any
                                     existing inversions, because the preceding day was warm and
                                     clear, and the lakes would store this warmth and release it at
                                     night. or further interest, is the fact that this sighting _                    •

                                     resembles many over Arizona and New Mexico in . the early 19~0's - ·
                                     the exploding green "fireball."
